lead.headline: The champ filled every hole. Now it’s a fight.
lead.dek: Maye I touch your TDs? added a tight end at 11:47 AM and a defense at 11:48 AM, and its lineup is done. Big Stric Energy is still favored, 58.1% to 41.9%, but only if Geno Smith’s ankle cooperates. Three teams, one playoff spot, two games.
lead.pull: Two moves, one minute apart. The to-do list is done.
body: Yesterday this column handed the champ a to-do list for an elimination game: Ward, a tight end, a defense, Bucky Irving. By Wed 11:48 AM every item was crossed off. Michael Mayer came in at 11:47 AM for the Cleveland Browns D/ST. The Buffalo Bills D/ST came in at 11:48 AM for Tyler Allgeier. Cam Ward is at QB next to Brock Purdy, Breece Hall and Omarion Hampton cover the FLEX spots Christian Watson and Drake London left on bye, and Irving starts.

The result: Maye I touch your TDs? projects for 142.89 as set, and its best possible lineup is 143.8. That is a finished roster. The only thing left is the kicker, Matt Gay, who is Questionable, and the only other gap is Jaylen Waddle (11.16, Questionable) on the bench behind Hampton (10.25).

Big Stric Energy is the opposite. As set it projects for 132.51, because Jordan Love is on bye in a QB slot. The fix is in-house: Geno Smith projects for 15.94 on the bench, and Saquon Barkley (12.59) is sitting behind Braelon Allen (8.88). Make both swaps and Big Stric is at 152.16, the favorite at 58.1%. The catch is the tags. Smith is Questionable with an ankle and his deadline is Sun 1:05 PM. Dalton Kincaid is Questionable with a thumb, and Tucker Kraft is on bye, so there is no tight end behind him.

The standings make this bigger than one game. Five teams are in or as good as in. The last spot belongs to Santa Clara’s Finest (3-7, 57.1%), the champ (2-8, 25.2%) or Big Stric (2-8, 17.7%). The Finest play 8-2 Poochinski, a 41.9% underdog. So the winner here needs a Finest loss too, and gets one with decent odds.

Big Stric gets the first word. Nico Collins (16.06) plays tonight, the only player in this matchup on Thursday. One small comedy: Big Stric starts Josh Allen, Kincaid and Tyler Bass, and the champ starts the Buffalo Bills D/ST. On Sunday both teams root for Buffalo.

My pick: I’m flipping to the champ. The numbers say Big Stric, but those numbers need two questionable players to suit up. The champ needs nothing. In a must-win week, a finished lineup is worth more than a better one on paper.

quick_hits.headline: Six R.A.T.S. starters play tonight
quick_hits.body: Week 11 opens tonight at 5:15 PM Pacific. The biggest single projection belongs to Bad things man bad things’ C.J. Stroud (20.41). deeboliciouskins starts Jonathan Taylor (14.36) and Tyler Warren (10.7), Big Stric Energy starts Nico Collins (16.06), and Santa Clara’s Finest start kicker Spencer Shrader (7.79) and the Houston Texans D/ST (8.81), which will be trying to stop deeboliciouskins’ Taylor and Warren.

quick_hits.headline: What will AB81 do at quarterback?
quick_hits.body: Still the biggest open question in the league. Matthew Stafford is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out, Jalen Hurts is on IR, and the bench has no quarterback. As set AB81 projects for 67.34; at best 105.48 against deeboliciouskins’ 168.84, 6.0%. The QB and FLEX spots both need the wire, and Xavier Hutchinson (7.6, 725,879 adds) plays tonight if AB81 wants a FLEX before kickoff.

quick_hits.headline: Burden at FLEX, and a defense still open
quick_hits.body: Poochinski’s FLEX call is easy: Luther Burden III (15.48) for Jadarian Price, on bye, by Sun 10:00 AM. The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is still on bye with no backup, and the Detroit Lions D/ST (7.56) is still unrostered and the most-added player in Sleeper (761,094). One more: Caleb Williams (20.59) is on the bench behind Aaron Rodgers (16.96).

quick_hits.headline: Coleman should play. The question is for whom.
quick_hits.body: Jonah Coleman (17.05) is the best player on Cherry Blossom’s bench. The math says he goes in for Jameson Williams (11.96), not Brock Bowers, who is Questionable but projects higher at 14.85. Bo Nix (17.89) over Jared Goff (16.66) finishes the best lineup: 163.82.

quick_hits.headline: The new guy picked up a tag
quick_hits.body: Bad things man bad things cut Ladd McConkey for Jordyn Tyson on Wednesday. Today Tyson is the one listed Questionable, with a chest injury, and the bench has no healthy receiver behind him. The rest of the lineup is set, and it projects for 147.84.

quick_hits.headline: Two teams, two kickers left
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins still starts Jason Myers, on bye and being dropped 274,965 times across Sleeper. The champ’s Matt Gay is Questionable. Cairo Santos (6.57) and Chase McLaughlin (6.21) are both free. There is one each.

w11-m1.headline: The finished lineup vs. the better one
w11-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy 152.16 at best, Maye I touch your TDs? 143.8, 58.1% Big Stric. The champ is done; Big Stric needs Geno Smith healthy and in for Jordan Love. Loser is likely out of the playoff race.

w11-m2.headline: AB81 needs a quarterback from somewhere
w11-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins 168.84, AB81 105.48 at best, 94.0% deeboliciouskins. Taylor and Warren play tonight. deeboliciouskins needs only a kicker; AB81 needs a QB and a FLEX off the wire.

w11-m3.headline: Cherry Blossom has the deeper bench
w11-m3.blurb: Cherry Blossom 163.82 at best, Bad things man bad things 147.84, 65.2% Cherry Blossom. Stroud starts tonight for Bad things. Coleman and Nix are Cherry Blossom’s upgrades sitting on the bench.

w11-m4.headline: Poochinski can end the Finest’s week
w11-m4.blurb: Poochinski 173.62 at best, Santa Clara’s Finest 165.32, 58.1% Poochinski. A Finest loss opens the last playoff spot to Week 11’s other game. Walker (Questionable) at RB is the Finest’s swing piece.

w11-r3-s1.headline: Resolved: Ward at QB
w11-r3-s1.blurb: Cam Ward (16.85) is in the champ’s empty QB slot next to Brock Purdy.

w11-r3-s6.headline: Resolved: Mayer at tight end
w11-r3-s6.blurb: Added at Wed 11:47 AM, in the lineup for Harold Fannin Jr. Michael Mayer projects for 8.58.

w11-r3-s10.headline: Resolved: Bills at defense
w11-r3-s10.blurb: The Buffalo Bills D/ST (9.07), added at Wed 11:48 AM, replaces the Cleveland Browns D/ST, which was on bye and is now gone.

w11-r3-s7.headline: Resolved: Hall and Hampton at FLEX
w11-r3-s7.blurb: Breece Hall (12.34) and Omarion Hampton (10.25) cover for Christian Watson and Drake London, both on bye.

w11-r1-s1.headline: What will Big Stric do at QB?
w11-r1-s1.blurb: Jordan Love is on bye. Geno Smith (15.94) is Questionable with an ankle and the only QB on the bench. He’s the whole season in one call. Deadline Sun 1:05 PM.

w11-r1-s6.headline: Kincaid’s thumb, and no Plan B
w11-r1-s6.blurb: Dalton Kincaid (9.68) is Questionable and Tucker Kraft is on bye. If Kincaid looks shaky this week, the answer is on the wire.

w11-r8-s6.headline: Kittle over Andrews
w11-r8-s6.blurb: AB81 starts Mark Andrews (7.25), who is being added 305,550 times elsewhere, with George Kittle (12.53) on its bench. I’d start Kittle. Deadline Sun 5:20 PM.

w11-r8-s4.headline: DeVonta Smith for Smith-Njigba
w11-r8-s4.blurb: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is on bye. DeVonta Smith (12.35, Questionable, hamstring) is the bench answer. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

w11-r7-s2.headline: Walker for Corum
w11-r7-s2.blurb: Blake Corum is on bye. Kenneth Walker III (18.29) is Questionable with a groin and the best RB the Finest have. Deadline Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-r7-s4.headline: Loveland for Boston
w11-r7-s4.blurb: Denzel Boston is on bye. Colston Loveland (11.07) goes in through a FLEX shuffle. Deadline Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-r4-s7.headline: Bowers or Coleman?
w11-r4-s7.blurb: Brock Bowers (14.85) is Questionable with an ankle. Jonah Coleman (17.05) is healthy. Coleman should start either way; if Bowers sits, he takes Bowers’ spot. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

w11-r6-s9.headline: deeboliciouskins needs a kicker
w11-r6-s9.blurb: Jason Myers is on bye. Cairo Santos (6.57) edges Chase McLaughlin (6.21).

2026-11-19-m1.blurb: Michael Mayer (8.58) for a Cleveland Browns D/ST on bye. A tight end slot that projected 0.0 now has a starter. This is how you play an elimination game.

2026-11-19-m2.blurb: The Buffalo Bills D/ST (9.07) for Tyler Allgeier (8.13), who wasn’t starting. The defense hole is closed and the cost was a bench running back.

external_facts.claim: Week 11 opens Thursday, November 19, with Indianapolis at Houston at 8:15 PM ET (5:15 PM Pacific).
